zh: 翻译仅在宿主和服务商能强制禁用工具时发送文本。当前可用的 Paseo 与服务商暂不满足条件，翻译暂不可用，设置页会说明原因。
en: Translation sends text only when the host and provider can enforce a tool-free session. Currently available Paseo hosts and providers do not meet this requirement, so translation is temporarily unavailable; Settings explains why.
